import base64,hashlib,json,subprocess,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; from pathlib import Path
base="dbae70f62c1fef14bad8048b10ac489a1e6cb109"
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()==base
assert not subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","HEAD","--name-only"],text=True).strip()
fix=Path("docs/agent/implementation-runs/managed-20261023-fix-manual-history-01")
identities=json.loads(json.loads((fix/"source-identity.json").read_text())["output"])
for p,h in identities.items(): assert hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,p
counts={"protocol":0,"native":0}
for p,entry in json.loads((fix/"junit.json").read_text()).items():
 raw=base64.b64decode(entry["base64"]); assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==entry["sha256"]
 suite=ET.fromstring(raw); assert all(int(suite.attrib[k])==0 for k in ("failures","errors","skipped"))
 counts["native" if p.startswith("androidApp/") else "protocol"]+=int(suite.attrib["tests"])
assert counts=={"protocol":72,"native":56},counts
old=Path("docs/agent/implementation-runs/managed-20261023-verify-manual-01/junit.json")
red=[]
for p,entry in json.loads(old.read_text()).items():
 raw=base64.b64decode(entry["base64"]); assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==entry["sha256"]
 red.extend(t.attrib["name"] for t in ET.fromstring(raw).findall("testcase") if t.find("failure") is not None)
assert any("explicitInspectionAnchorsPendingTapRun" in n for n in red),red
state="docs/agent/implementation-state.json"
assert Path(state).read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(["git","show",base+":"+state])
print(json.dumps({"inspectedCommit":base,"unchangedFixingSourceIdentities":len(identities),"reusedPassingExecutions":counts,"originalRedCasesPreserved":red,"stateSha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(state).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"trackedCandidateBytesUnchanged":True},indent=2))
